description: This file implements microphone handling for Windows UWP platform, including device enumeration, audio graph creation, microphone input processing, and interface implementation for starting/stopping and reading microphone data.

classes.name: MutedTrigger
classes.description: Detects if microphone has been muted for a certain duration.

classes.name: MicrophoneProcessor
classes.description: Encapsulates Microsoft's audio API, manages microphone devices, and processes audio data into PCM format.

classes.name: MicrophoneImpl
classes.description: Implements the SbMicrophonePrivate interface, manages microphone lifecycle and data reading.

methods.name: To16BitPcm
methods.description: Converts float audio samples in [-1.0, 1.0] to 16-bit PCM.

methods.name: IsUiThread
methods.description: Checks if current thread is the UI thread.

methods.name: LaunchMicrophonePermissionsAppAsync
methods.description: Launches app to request microphone permissions.

methods.name: CreateAudioGraph
methods.description: Creates an AudioGraph with specified settings.

methods.name: GenerateAudioInputNodes
methods.description: Creates input nodes for each microphone device.

methods.name: ExtractRawAudioData
methods.description: Extracts float audio data from an AudioFrameOutputNode.
